purpose: 一次采集 base/donor logits 与 donor terminal hidden，随后离线回放 alpha、校准门和验证多 donor

base_logits.tap: base final LM head output, before any donor contribution

labels.rule: teacher target in base vocabulary; evaluation only

task_ids.rule: split/report only; forbidden as gate input

donor_i_logits.tap: donor output norm/head logits for exactly mapped donor rows, before centering or alpha

donor_i_base_ids.rule: unique exact-token-byte map into base vocabulary

donor_i_hidden.tap: donor terminal hidden before donor output norm

manifest_required: base and every donor model SHA-256
tensor tap names and pre/post norm status
invariants: all rows describe the same teacher-forced prefix boundary across base and donors
alpha=0 offline reconstruction is exactly base_logits
target labels and task ids never enter gate features
unmapped base tokens receive zero donor residual
